problems: The Elenchus prints NO column numbers (only the cross-ref cols 125, 207 and a stray '6' after De processione); every column is body-confirmed with the Ordo as cross-check, so colStatus is body-only except where noted.

Ordo digits are heavily garbled; where Ordo and body differ I trust the body (header chain). Differences: Expositio fidei Ordo 255 vs 233; Contra Marcum 241 vs 247; Epistola ad Andronicum 261 vs 267; Dissertatio prima 41 vs 47; Encomium Andronici 347 vs 387; Encomium maris 435 vs 433; Epistola encyclica 628 vs 607; Oratio II 969 vs 565; textus alter 637 vs 657; Epitomes Liber II 1003 vs 1005; Expositio in Psalmos 1331 vs 1321.

Page numbers for several pages were counted from the last explicit header (OCR lost them): Monitum 227, Expositio 233, Encomium maris 433, Athanasius title page 471 (inferred; no numbers on the title page itself), Expositio in Psalmos 1321.

Georgius Cyprius Apologetica (Expositio fidei, Contra Marcum, Apologia, Epistola ad Andronicum, De processione) print two Greek columns with no Latin version in the OCR (greek-only); Chila's epistle likewise.

Elenchus parentheticals '(Huc usque Georgii scripta ab Anselmo Bandurio edita)' and '(Cf. not. Editoris Patrologiae ...)' are not items. Elenchus 'Epistola ad amicum' and 'ad Andronicum' are cross-refs within this same volume, entered as crossref with crossRefVolume 142.

Omitted editorial matter not in the Elenchus: Editorum Patrologiae Monitum (before the Sermo, col 585), Wegelinus's prefaces to the logic and physics, Index in logicam (line 120453) and Index in physicam (lines 121199, 121501), plus the Ordo's own chapter lists. Ordo-only work entered: Athanasius's eight residence letters.
Georgius Vita parts (Notae, Dissertationes, the two letters) and Athanasius Epistola parts come from the Ordo only; not body-confirmed.
